recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量很多，顆粒球系與紅血球系各階段前驅細胞都增加（全骨髓增生，panmyelosis），並可見體積大、核分葉多的巨核細胞（下方中央及左上），這種三系增生加上大型巨核細胞的樣貌符合真性紅血球增多症的增生期，但需搭配 JAK2 突變與臨床數據。
features: Increased granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands
Erythroid precursors present in increased numbers with orderly maturation
Large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei (lower centre and upper left)
No increase in blasts and no obvious dysplasia in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is highly cellular with trilineage proliferation. Granulocytic precursors show full maturation, erythroid precursors are numerous with orderly maturation, and several large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobated nuclei are present. Blasts are not increased and no significant dysplasia is evident. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera in the appropriate clinical and molecular context (elevated hemoglobin/hematocrit, JAK2 mutation).

ddx.vs: Secondary erythrocytosis shows isolated erythroid hyperplasia without granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation or large hyperlobated megakaryocytes, and has normal or high erythropoietin with no JAK2 mutation.
ET shows proliferation mainly of large to giant megakaryocytes with staghorn nuclei without significant granulocytic or erythroid panmyelosis.
Prefibrotic PMF shows granulocytic proliferation with reduced erythropoiesis and dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei, best assessed on the trephine.
CML shows marked granulocytic hyperplasia with a myelocyte bulge, basophilia and small hypolobated dwarf megakaryocytes, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
